# The Rhythm Behind Tony Drake's Success


Some people are energized by solving problems. Others thrive on meeting new people. For Tony Drake, Territory Sales Manager, the most rewarding part of the job is combining both.


Supporting customers across Texas and Oklahoma means every day is different. One conversation might focus on finding the right product solution, while the next involves helping a dealer navigate a challenge or seize a new opportunity. It is the variety, and the people behind it, that keeps Tony motivated.


*"I like meeting people and building relationships,"* he says. *"That's what I enjoy most about my job."*


After 16 years with JELD-WEN, Tony has built a career centered on service, adaptability and a genuine desire to help others succeed.


**Beyond sales**


Growing up in Detroit, Tony developed a passion for music that remains an important part of his life today. A longtime fan of house music and techno, he DJs in his spare time, using music as a creative outlet.


What started as an interest years ago has become a lifelong hobby. Whether he's mixing tracks for friends or performing at local events, Tony enjoys the creativity and energy that come with being behind the turntables.


While DJing may seem far removed from sales, both require the ability to stay adaptable, read a situation and respond in the moment. For Tony, music provides a balance to the fast-paced nature of his work and an opportunity to express a different side of himself.


“A good DJ reads the room and knows how to respond to the crowd. A good salesperson listens, adapts and helps customers find what they need,” he said. That ability to connect has become one of Tony's greatest strengths, both professionally and personally.


**Listening first**


Ask Tony what matters most in sales, and he won't start by talking about products or numbers.


Instead, he'll talk about listening.


Throughout his career, he's learned that the best solutions come from first understanding a customer's needs. Taking the time to ask questions, gather information and see challenges from the customer's perspective has helped him become a valued resource for dealers throughout his territory.


The problem-solving aspect of the role is what Tony enjoys most. Whether helping a customer work through an issue or identifying a new opportunity, he takes pride in finding solutions that support their goals and contribute to long-term success.


**Making an impact**


When he's not working, Tony enjoys traveling and exploring new places. Experiencing different cultures and communities has broadened his perspective and fueled his natural curiosity.


He is also active in Alpha Phi Alpha Fraternity, Incorporated, where he participates in community service initiatives and opportunities to give back. Supporting causes that make a difference is something he values deeply and an important way he stays engaged in his community.


Whether he's visiting a new destination or volunteering his time, Tony believes some of life's most meaningful experiences come from learning, serving and stepping outside of your comfort zone.


**Advice that stuck**


One lesson has remained with Tony throughout his career.


Early on, a manager encouraged him to be more vocal about his accomplishments and contributions.


*"Know your worth and tell people about what you're doing,"* he says. *"People don't know if you don't tell them."*


The advice left a lasting impression and continues to influence how he approaches his career. It's also a lesson he hopes to pass along to others, including his daughter, as they pursue their own goals and ambitions.


**More than a job**


For Tony, success isn't measured solely by sales goals or business results. It's about continuing to learn, helping others overcome challenges and making a positive impact wherever he can.


Whether he's supporting customers, volunteering in his community or sharing music with a crowd, Tony brings the same sense of purpose to everything he does.


After 16 years with JELD-WEN, that approach continues to define his career, one built on service, curiosity and a commitment to leaving things better than he found them.
